response.sql: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(TAT - TAT2) AS avg_tat_diff FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN `U-PRO` = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN RA = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0) SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS average_pt, AVG(avg_tat_diff) AS average_tat_minus_tat2 FROM per_patient;
